html:
SMTO-CTR-0025 — A check found the task plan doesn't cover everything it should

GUID: 2808bed3-6eec-4acb-8352-fdae9090b07c
Slug: task-contract-coverage-missing
Domain: CTR · Subsystem: ctr

What happened

  • A separate check of a Task Contract (the step-by-step plan SMTO writes from a request) found it lists no requirements, or its rule for 'done' leaves some out. The check didn't run or change anything.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open Technical details in this panel to see what is missing: no link back to the request, no requirements at all, or a 'done' rule that skips some requirements. The named gap shows which part of the plan has to be filled in.
  2. Reread your request and add, in plain words, what must be true when the work is finished. A request that states the expected result gives SMTO clear requirements to put into the plan.
  3. Send the improved request so SMTO writes a new Task Contract. Don't submit the same plan again unchanged. An unchanged plan fails this check every time, while a new plan is checked from scratch.

What success looks like

  • The check passes for the new Task Contract, or the new task shows Task contract generated and starts working.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them, with your request text, to the person who manages SMTO. Don't treat a plan that failed this check as approved to run.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Offline TaskContract structure validation found incomplete coverage: a non-clarification contract has no source coverage, no requirements, or completion criteria that omit required requirements or invariants.

What this means

  • Structural validation of a non-clarification contract finds no coverage, no requirements or completion coverage that omits required requirements/invariants. This condition is produced by an explicit offline contract diagnostic, not the current compiler acceptance gate. It reports only the named check and cannot authorize execution or prove complete semantic fidelity.

Why this can happen

  • Structural validation of a non-clarification contract finds no coverage, no requirements or completion coverage that omits required requirements/invariants.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the explicit schema/offline coverage result separately from the current compiler's narrow acceptance gate.

How to fix it

  • Read the specific rule in the error text (source_coverage_missing, requirements_missing or completion_coverage_missing). Correct or regenerate the contract so it has coverage entries, at least one requirement, and completion.required_requirement_ids and required_invariant_ids that equal every requirement and invariant ID. This is an offline diagnostic in task_contract_models.py, not the compiler acceptance gate.
  • Review and correct source/requirement/completion coverage through the existing contract flow.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The corrected inspected contract covers all intended requirements and invariants.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • This condition is produced by an explicit offline contract diagnostic, not the current compiler acceptance gate. It reports only the named check and cannot authorize execution or prove complete semantic fidelity.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
